caption: The drawing depicts a sword with an ornate handle and partial scabbard, rendered primarily in shades of gray and brown. The sword's hilt features a detailed animal head, possibly a lion or eagle, forming the pommel, with a curved guard studded with round decorations. The grip of the sword is ribbed, appearing to be ivory or bone colored, and the crossguard displays elaborate designs. The scabbard, shown partially enclosing the blade, is colored brown with metallic, silver-gray fittings at the top, middle, and bottom. Additionally, two separate fragments of the scabbard are illustrated on the right and left sides of the drawing, both showing the same brown coloration with metallic fittings and jagged, broken ends. The drawing is set within a square border and includes the signature "HANKS" in the lower left corner.
title: Sword
